Eightgen is an AI services company that partners with founders, CIOs, and CXOs to transform ideas into working products. We help startups and enterprises ship AI automation at scale—from intelligent workflows and custom AI agents to enterprise-grade applications.

Our Values

Integrity & Ethics
We conduct business with honesty and transparency. We do what's right for our clients, our team, and our partners—even when it's harder. We handle data responsibly and respect the trust placed in us.

Quality & Accountability
We take ownership of our work and deliver on our commitments. We build software we're proud of, with attention to detail and a commitment to excellence. When we make mistakes, we acknowledge them and fix them.

Trust & Autonomy
We hire talented people and give them the freedom to do their best work. We communicate openly, share context generously, and trust each other to make good decisions.

Inclusion & Belonging
We are committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels welcome, respected, and heard. Different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us stronger.

We are a fully remote team that values outcomes over hours and collaboration over hierarchy.

The Role

As an AI Engineer Lead, you will be a hands-on technical leader for our AI engineering work — spending roughly 70% of your time designing, building, and shipping AI systems, and the remaining 30% providing technical direction, reviewing AI/ML work, and mentoring engineers on the team.

You will own the end-to-end design of the LLM-powered features, agents, and data pipelines your team builds — from prompt and retrieval strategy to evaluation, guardrails, and production deployment. This is not a pure research role, not a data-science/notebook role, and not a people-management role: we want a strong software engineer who can take an AI problem from a vague business goal to a reliable, evaluated, production-grade system — owning the services, APIs, and data flow around the model, not just the model — and lead a small team through it.

We are an AI-native engineering team. You will build with LLMs (as the product) and using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as integral tools in your workflow — and you'll set that standard for the team. Much of our work involves multi-agent systems — orchestrating teams of LLM agents through long-running, human-in-the-loop workflows — so comfort building and reasoning about agentic systems is central to the role.

Our AI Engineering Philosophy

We believe the most effective AI engineers are those who:

• 
Measure before they trust — every agent, RAG pipeline, or fine-tune ships with an evaluation harness, a labeled dataset, and a clear definition of "good enough"; quality is gated on metrics, not vibes, and regressions are caught before they ship

• 
Treat AI systems as software — versioned prompts, reproducible pipelines, tests, and observability — not one-off notebook experiments

• 
Engineer around model limits — design for hallucination, latency, cost, and non-determinism from day one, with retries, fallbacks, and guardrails

• 
Stay pragmatic about the stack — reach for the simplest thing that works (a good prompt over a fine-tune, retrieval over a bigger model) and only add complexity when the metrics demand it

• 
Keep humans in control — AI accelerates the work, but quality, safety, and correctness remain the engineer's responsibility

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead AI delivery end-to-end — own the design and delivery of the LLM features, agents, and pipelines your team is building, define standards within that scope, and ship reliable, maintainable AI systems on time

• 
Design agentic AI systems — produce technical designs for RAG pipelines, multi-step and multi-agent (lead + sub-agent) systems, tool-use/function-calling flows, and long-running orchestrations with human-in-the-loop gates, with a clear eye on accuracy, latency, cost, and failure modes

• 
Build evaluation and observability — define metrics, build eval datasets and harnesses, and instrument LLM calls so quality and regressions are visible, not guessed at

•

The role provides architecture ownership, technical governance and assurance across all Ekiva programmes and opportunities – from publicly funded innovation projects through to commercial network deployments, enterprise private networks and operator solutions.

The Technical Director reports to the Chief Executive Officer and leads the technology function, including the Head of Orchestration & Network Intelligence and the wider engineering, architecture and integration team.

This is a builder’s role. Ekiva’s technology function is being reshaped, and the Technical Director will recruit, mentor and lead the team from the ground up, establishing the standards, processes and technical culture on which the business will scale. The role combines strategic and architectural leadership with sufficient hands-on credibility to review, challenge and validate the work of internal teams, subcontractors and consortium partners.

The role is positioned to grow. It carries a clear development path towards executive technology leadership within Ekiva as the technology function, portfolio and commercial footprint expand.

**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**

1. **Technical Strategy and Architecture Authority**

- Own the end-to-end technical architecture of Ekiva’s platform and solutions across private 5G / SNPN, Open RAN, 5G Core, orchestration, FWA and operator networks.
- Define and maintain the technology roadmap, aligning technical direction with business strategy, market opportunity and funding commitments.
- Act as design authority: review, challenge and approve architectures, designs, interfaces and technical decisions before commitment.
- Own the boundary between Ekiva-developed intellectual property and licensed or third-party technology, protecting the Company’s technical and commercial independence.
- Set technical standards, engineering practices and quality gates across all projects.
- Technology Business Planning & Financial Governance – Strengthen ownership of CAPEX/OPEX planning, technology investment decisions, market feasibility assessments and ROI evaluation to support business growth and investment decisions.
- Regulatory, Spectrum & Market Deployment Strategy – Enhance focus on international market deployment requirements, telecom regulatory alignment and spectrum planning considerations across different regions.

2. **Innovate UK Programme Leadership**

- Provide technical leadership across Ekiva’s Innovate UK collaborative R&D programmes, ensuring work package delivery to milestone, specification and evidence requirements.
- Represent Ekiva as the technical voice within consortia, working alongside catapults, universities, vendors and network operators.
- Ensure technical deliverables, test evidence and reporting meet the standards required for grant milestone claims and audit.
- Oversee technical due diligence, acceptance and assurance of subcontracted and partner-delivered work.
- Safeguard the Company’s foreground and background intellectual property position, supporting the IP register and exploitation planning.

3. **Enterprise Private Networks (EPN)**

- Lead the technical definition, architecture and feasibility assessment of Enterprise Private Network opportunities.
- Develop repeatable reference architectures and deployment models for target verticals, including industrial, utilities, transport and secure environments.
- Support bids, proposals and customer engagements with solution architecture, technical narrative and credible costing input.
- Translate innovation programme outputs into commercially deployable products and services.

4. **Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) and Mobile Network Operator (MNO) Business**

- This is a distinct and growing area of Ekiva’s business, covering the design, deployment and operation of broadband FWA and MNO solutions in international markets.
- Own the technical strategy and end-to-end architecture for FWA and MNO solutions, from access network through core, transport and service platforms.
- Lead radio network design and planning – spectrum strategy, coverage and capacity modelling, RF planning, site selection and CPE selection – directly or through ecosystem partners.
- Approve the architecture of ISP and operator core infrastructure, including core network, transport, service delivery platforms and OSS/BSS interfaces.
- Direct deployment readiness and execution: installation standards, integration, acceptance testing, service activation and operational handover.
- Establish network operations capability and support models, including first and second line support, monitoring, KPI frameworks and service quality standards.
- Provide equipment, budget and resourcing recommendations; support vendor selection, technical evaluation and contract negotiation.
- Work with ecosystem and delivery partners to ensure alignment and effective delivery of jointly developed solutions from design through to market launch.
- Provide technical input to commercial models, business cases and investment decisions for network deployments.

5. **Build and Lead the Technology Team**

- Build Ekiva’s technology function from the ground up – define the structure, roles and capability required to deliver the current and future portfolio.
- Recruit, onboard and develop engineers, architects and specialists; act as the technical assessor in the hiring process.
- Lead, mentor and set direction for the Head of Orchestration & Network Intelligence and the wider technical team.
- Set clear objectives, KPIs and development plans; grow individual and collective technical capability.
- Establish knowledge management, documentation and technical training so capability is retained and transferred within the Company.
- Foster a culture of engineering rigour, innovation, continuous learning and constructive technical challenge.
- Manage the balance of in-house, outsourced and subcontracted resource to deliver efficiently and within budget.

6. **Technical Governance, Assurance and Delivery**

- Establish and chair design gates, architecture reviews and technical acceptance processes across all projects.
- Own technical risk identification, mitigation and escalation, and provide delivery-readiness assessment ahead of key milestones.
- Ensure security, resilience and regulatory considerations are designed in from the outset, including for critical national infrastructure environments.
- Work with the Programme Director and PMO to ensure technical delivery is aligned to schedule, budget and contractual commitments.
- Technology Portfolio & Resource Governance – Strengthen responsibility for prioritising technology initiatives across R&D programmes, commercial deployments and operational networks, ensuring alignment of technical resources with business objectives.

7. **Partner, Vendor and Ecosystem Management**

- Own the technical relationship with technology partners, licensors, subcontractors and ecosystem collaborators.
- Set specifications, review deliverables and hold partners to account for technical quality and scope.
- Represent Ekiva in industry forums, standards bodies and technical working groups where it advances the Company’s position.
- Maintain awareness of standards evolution, competitive developments and emerging technology relevant to Ekiva’s markets.

8. **Stakeholder Engagement and Communication**

- Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, customers, funders, investors and policy stakeholders.
- Support the leadership team with technical input to strategy, commercial and investment decisions.
- Act as a credible external technical ambassador for Ekiva.

9. **Additional Duties**

- Support Executive Leadership Team with other relevant tasks.
- Support President and the ELT on an ad-hoc basis.

- Manage your own and your team’s compliance with quality, health and safety rules, instructions, systems and legal requirements, ensuring employees are suitably trained and adequate resources are available to work safely.

Rapidly expanding globally, the brand is available in over 45 countries and is continually introducing new and revolutionary products to the market. A brand with true integrity, passion and commitment, ELEMIS is award-winning, results-driven and visionary – just like our people.

Working at ELEMIS means joining a team of talented individuals who work together to create unique beauty experiences. It means integrating a dynamic group where innovation, exceeding customer expectations and setting new industry standards is part of everyday business.

Job Role Description
Operations & Project Engineer
The Operations & Project Engineer is responsible for the installation, servicing, maintenance,
repair and replacement of District Networks, such as (HIUs), heat pipes, pumps and
associated mechanical components within heating and hot water systems.

The role involves carrying out planned and reactive maintenance, diagnosing faults,
replacing defective components and ensuring systems are operating safely, efficiently and
reliably. The engineer will work to relevant health and safety requirements, manufacturer
guidelines and company procedures while delivering a high standard of workmanship and
customer service.

Responsibilities
• Install, commission and maintain Heat Interface Units (HIUs) and associated heating
and hot water equipment.

• Carry out planned, preventative and reactive repairs or upgrades to District Heating
Systems.

• Diagnose and rectify faults affecting heating, hot water, circulation and system
performance.

• Repair, replace and maintain heat pipes, pipework, valves, fittings and associated
components.

• Repair, replace, install and maintain heating and circulation pumps.

• Identify defective or worn components and determine the appropriate repair or
replacement required.

• Carry out system checks, testing and functional checks following installation or repair
work.

• Investigate issues such as loss of heating or hot water, poor circulation, leaks,
abnormal pump operation and other system faults.

• Safely isolate, drain, dismantle and reinstate equipment when undertaking repairs or
component replacements.

• Ensure completed work is tested and left in a safe, clean and fully operational
condition.

• Follow manufacturer installation and maintenance instructions and relevant technical
procedures.

About the role

ElevateSP is a GTM systems consultancy specialising in Clay-based automation for sales and recruitment clients. We build the infrastructure that turns raw market data into clean, enriched, routable pipelines.

We're looking for a junior GTM Engineer to support on live client builds on a freelance basis. This is hands-on delivery work, not strategy. You'll be building and maintaining real systems under guidance.

What you'd work on

Building candidate and prospect sourcing pipelines that pull from data providers via API and enrich records at scale

Designing search logic around job titles, seniority, and locations to hit the right audience

Deduplication and routing — making sure records are clean, unique, and pushed to the right destination (databases, CRMs, outbound tools)

Data enrichment and validation across large lists (tens to hundreds of thousands of records)

Pushing structured data into client databases and downstream systems via API

What we're looking for

Logical, structured thinker who can look at a data problem and reason through the steps

Comfortable with spreadsheets, basic data concepts, and ideally some exposure to Clay, APIs, or no-code automation

Reliable and communicative on a freelance basis

Genuinely curious about GTM engineering as a craft

Interview process

1

Short Clay task (take-home)

We'll send you a scenario with some sample data and ask you to build a small workflow in Clay. It tests how you reason, not whether you know every feature. We want to see your logic more than a polished result.

2

30-minute call

You walk us through what you built and why. We'll talk through your thinking, answer your questions, and see if there's a fit.

Your CV

At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and a year ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling Bank has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. The Engine technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

Our people are at the very heart of Engine and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of London so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About Engineering at Engine by Starling - https://enginebystarling.com/

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Technology team at Engine. You will be responsible for delivering a critical, strategic programmes within a technical and product domain. 

This role will involve technical understanding with complex strategic coordination in a multi-client environment. You will support product consultants, engineering leads and our account managers with planning and commitment setting, as we scale internationally and continue to grow our client base with competing needs. 

Working closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams and reporting directly into Engineering, along with external payment schemes and technology providers, you will oversee the end-to-end implementation of a diverse range of complex projects across different areas of the business. Reporting directly to Engineering and collaborating closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams, your role will be to manage the end-to-end implementation of various complex projects. This will involve working across different business areas and engaging with external payment schemes and technology providers.

We're looking for someone who thrives delivering in a flexible environment; previous experience working in Financial Services or Technology companies would be an advantage. This role has room to grow, with opportunities to take on wider programme management of challenging inter-woven engineering and product deliveries.

If you’re interested, our main backend stack is; Java microservices in Kubernetes (EKS), on AWS & GCP using TeamCity for CI / CD (with multiple production releases per day) backed by Terraform and Grafana.

What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities

- Overall management and co-ordination of a technical programme, managing a portfolio of multiple complex, inter-dependent projects. You’ll serve as the key bridge between Engineering, Clients and our Delivery partners.
- Work closely with Engineering Leads to support the Software Development Lifecycle, understanding work dependencies and complexities. Collaborate across multiple teams to coordinate work and effort. Support Product and Engineering to produce an achievable plan.
- Working with Product Leads to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of all client competing needs against our internal capacity. Proactively identifying risks of over-commitment to ensure realistic delivery timelines.
- Owning relationships with external parties such as vendors and payment schemes. Ensuring service is provided to a high standard and holding them accountable where they play a key role in project delivery.
- Provide key reporting and metrics for delivery progress and tracking against plans.
- Continually monitor processes and implement improvements.

Requirements

Ideally you will have:

- End-to-end Project or Programme Management experience, ideally within a technology or financial services environment.
- Proven experience working directly with Engineering and Product teams to deliver complex technical solutions and experience in the software-as-a-service sector.
- A 'hands-on' and adaptable approach to programme delivery, with the ability to thrive in a flexible, fast-paced environment where priorities can shift.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience communicating complex technical topics.
- Strong interpersonal skills and a creative problem-solving ability to navigate ambiguity and technical hurdles.
- Technical skills and the ability to talk to Product and Engineering teams.
- Strong experience working on cards projects is highly desirable

Our interview process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

1. First interview (60 mins) - with someone from the team to get to know you, discuss the role, your skills, and how we work at Engine.
2. Final interview (45 mins) - with the Technical Programme Manager and Engineering Director

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Payments Director to lead our Payments  function and ensure that our payments services operate safely, reliably and in line with our regulatory and scheme obligations.

Sitting within Technology and reporting to the Chief IT Control Officer, this is a senior leadership role with responsibility for providing effective oversight and control of the Bank’s payments ecosystem. You will lead the Payments team, ensuring payment risks are understood and appropriately managed, regulatory and scheme requirements are met, and our critical third party relationships are effectively governed.

You will work across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and the wider business providing clear ownership and leadership when issues arise and helping us maintain a resilient, well controlled payments environment as the Bank continues to grow.

**Why this role matters:**

Payments are at the heart of our customers’ experience and are one of the most critical services we provide.

At Starling, we want to move quickly and continue to innovate, but we also need to ensure that our payments services remain safe, resilient, compliant and well controlled.

As Payments Director, you’ll play a central role in achieving the balance. You’ll bring together technology, risk, regulation, suppliers and schemes to ensure we understand our exposures, respond effectively when things go wrong and continue to strengthen our payments capability as the bank grows.

**What you'll get to do**

You will provide leadership and oversight across the Bank’s payments activities, with particular responsibility for: 

- Payment risk and control - ensuring risks across the payments estate are identified, assessed and effectively managed, with a strong and proportionate control environment.
- Regulatory and scheme compliance - ensuring the bank understands and meets its obligations relating to payments, including applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards and payment scheme rules
- Scheme Management - owning and overseeing key relationships with payment schemes and networks, including Mastercard, ensuring obligations are met and changes, issues and risks are appropriately managed
- Supplier and third party management - providing effective oversight of critical payment suppliers and partners, ensuring appropriate performance, governance, risk management and escalation arrangements are in place
- Incident Management - providing senior leadership and oversight of payment incidents, ensuring issues are managed effectively from identification through to resolution, with appropriate stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and remediation.
- Operational Resilience - ensuring payment services are resilient and recoverable, with appropriate contingency arrangements, testing and oversight of critical interdependencies
- Change and emerging risk - assessing the risk and control implications of changes to payment products, platforms, regulation, schemes and suppliers, ensuring appropriate controls are embedded from the outset.
- Governance and reporting - providing clear and insightful reporting on payment risks, incident, supplier performance, compliance and emerging issues to senior management and relevant governance forums.
- Leadership - leading and developing a high performing payments team, establishing clear accountability and building strong relationships across Technology and the wider bank.

## Requirements

You will bring significant leadership experience within payments, ideally gained within a bank, fintech, payments provider or similar regulated financial services environment.

You will have a strong understanding of the payments landscape and the risks associated with delivering critical payment services. You’ll be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, operations, risk and regulation, and able to translate complex payment issues into clear decisions and outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

- Deep knowledge of payment services, payment schemes and associated regulatory requirements
- Strong experience of payments risk management, controls, and governance
- Experience managing relationships with card schemes, payment networks, processors and other critical third parties
- A strong understanding of technology and operational risk within a regulated environment
- Experience leading the response to significant payment or technology incidents and driving effective remediation
- Knowledge of operational resilience and the management of critical services and third party dependencies
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the credibility to influence senior leaders, suppliers, schemes and other external parties
- The ability to provide constructive challenge while remaining pragmatic and commercially aware
- Proven experience leading and developing teams in a fast-moving environment.

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

The Security Architecture team at Starling is driving significant impact across the organisation, actively guiding and empowering teams across Security and the wider technology landscape. We are looking for a mid-to-senior level Information Security Architect to join our ranks.

While you will cover typical end-to-end security architecture across our modern tech stack, this role carries a strategic focus: Cryptography & Post-Quantum Readiness. As quantum computing capabilities evolve, we are looking to ramp up our Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) efforts. - Lead our Post-Quantum Strategy: Take ownership of Starling’s Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) initiative over the coming years; designing our crypto-inventory, evaluating PQC algorithms, and designing architectures built for cryptographic agility.

- Enterprise Architecture Delivery: Architect secure, scalable solutions across AWS and GCP, translating complex security requirements into simple, pragmatic design patterns for engineering teams.
- Secure Architecture Governance: Lead and assist with secure design reviews and threat modeling initiatives, delivering actionable security guidance and continuous support to Engineering teams.
- Proof of Concept Development: Our architects enjoy a hands-on approach. When suitable, we design and build PoC solutions for engineers to refine or draw inspiration from.
- Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with software engineers, cloud architects, and security operations to review RFCs and ADRs, conduct threat models, and embed security seamlessly into the development lifecycle without adding friction.
- Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor within our growing Security Architecture team, staying ahead of industry trends, threat vectors, and regulatory standards to elevate Starling's overall security posture.

- Architect end-to-end security solutions for cloud-native applications, microservices, and modern banking platforms.
- Develop and lead our Post-Quantum Cryptography transition roadmap and crypto-inventory strategy.
- Perform threat modeling and technical risk assessments on new and existing platform architectures.
- Define, document, and promote enterprise cryptographic management standards (key lifecycle, hardware security, modern cipher suites).
- Review architectural design documents, RFCs, and ADRs to ensure alignment with security guardrails and regulatory requirements.
- Mentor engineering teams and provide guidance on cryptographic implementations, securely managing secrets, and data protection at rest/in transit.
- Support the rest of the Security Architecture team with daily security architecture activities (e.g. adhoc security architecture advisory services).

- Deep Cryptography Expertise: Comprehensive practical and theoretical knowledge of symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, PKI management, digital signatures, key management systems (KMS), and HSMs.
- Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Knowledge: Strong understanding of quantum computing threats to modern encryption, NIST PQC standards, hybrid key exchange, and strategies for achieving crypto-agility.

- Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of distilling complex technical/cryptographic risks into clear guidance for both technical teams and senior leadership.

## People Coordinator

##### Role Overview

Location: Northenden, Manchester | Office-based Monday to Friday

**POWWR** provides advanced platforms and simple solutions for over 30 energy suppliers and more than 1,400 brokers across the United Kingdom. It empowers energy suppliers and brokers to grow their businesses and create a transparent, connected journey. The company was previously known as UD Group in the United Kingdom.

We are currently seeking a highly organised and proactive **People Coordinator** to join our People team. This is a varied, hands-on role supporting recruitment, travel, meetings, People administration and the day-to-day running of our Manchester office. We’re looking for someone who loves being organised, enjoys working with people and takes pride in making sure things happen when they should. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing and ambitious company and play an important role in both our People team and the experience of colleagues working from and visiting our office.

##### What You Will Be Doing

No two days will necessarily look the same. You’ll provide coordination and administrative support across the People team while also helping to ensure our office runs smoothly.

##### Key Responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for:

- Coordinating recruitment activity, including advertising vacancies, arranging interviews and managing candidate communications.
- Liaising with candidates and hiring managers to ensure a positive and well-organised recruitment experience.
- Arranging business travel including flights, trains, hotels and itineraries.
- Organising meetings, coordinating diaries and booking meeting rooms.
- Collating meeting notes and ensuring key actions are accurately captured.
- Maintaining action logs, diarising follow-ups and chasing agreed actions to completion.
- Supporting new starter and onboarding activities.
- Providing general People administration and maintaining accurate documentation.
- Supporting the organisation of internal events and employee activities.
- Helping organise visitors and ensuring meeting spaces are prepared.
- Supporting the general day-to-day organisation of the Manchester office.
- Acting as a helpful and approachable point of contact for colleagues.
- Supporting wider People projects and initiatives when required.

##### Qualifications and Skills

Above everything else, we’re looking for someone who is **organised, proactive and great with people**.

You’ll need:

- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage several different priorities at the same time.
- A proactive approach and a willingness to take ownership and get things done.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence dealing with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels.
- The ability to follow up and chase actions in a positive but persistent way.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word and Excel.
- The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- A flexible approach and willingness to help wherever needed.
- Previous experience in administration, coordination, recruitment, HR/People or office support would be an advantage.

##### Desirable Skills

Previous HR experience isn't essential. For us, finding someone with the **right attitude, organisation skills and willingness to learn** is just as important. Because of the hands-on nature of the position, you will need to be based in our **Manchester office Monday to Friday**.

##### What's In It For You?

- Competitive salary up to 34K

- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

- Cashplan & 24/7 GP service

- Death in Service cover

- Blended learning culture with personal development plans

- Annual company bonus scheme for high contribution

- Annual company conferences & team events

We believe in equal opportunities and encourage applicants to apply to our open roles regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, ethnicity, religion, neurodiversity, sexual orientation and/or age._

At Eni, we are looking for a Senior Market Risk Analyst (Products) to join Eni
Trade & Biofuels (ETB) in London, UK. You will be responsible for providing
daily performance and market risk analysis for the oil trading business in
London, working closely with traders and other teams across ETB.

The team is constantly striving to improve its procedures through automation and
a significant aspect of the role will be to continue the development of software
to streamline daily processes and enhance the team’s analytic capabilities. In
addition, the team is currently developing software to assist front office in
system trading, using a variety of techniques including machine learning and
artificial intelligence. There would be scope within this role to participate in
the development of these tools.

Immerse yourself in the fast evolving world of energy trading, particularly
within the growing biofuels market. ETB is committed to your professional
development, offering a dynamic environment that values knowledge, innovation
and career progression.

About ETB

ETB is the crude oil, refined oil products and biofuels trading and shipping
company of Eni. We are a diverse and dynamic team of around 300 professionals
distributed in three offices (Rome, London and Singapore) with the addition in
Houston of Eni Trading & Shipping Inc. (ETS Inc) which handles marketing of oils
and petroleum products for the US market. Our team is also involved in marketing
Eni’s oil equity productions, sourcing hydrocarbons and bio feedstocks, and
managing the output of our traditional and green refineries.

ETB is at the cutting edge of sustainability and innovation in the global energy
market. As a dynamic force within the Eni group, which is a leader in the energy
transition, at ETB we are rapidly establishing ourselves as a key player in the
new energy landscape, with a sharp focus on biofuels trading. Our work with bio
feedstock and bioproducts is central to our mission of shaping a sustainable
future. When you join ETB, you become part of Eni – a leading global energy
company with over 32,000 employees in 61 countries. Eni is at the forefront of
the energy industry, specializing in exploration, production, transport, and
marketing of oil, natural gas and biofuels.

Main responsibilities

 * Prepare and review daily PnL and risk reports, monitoring limits, and
   proactively resolving any issues in coordination with the relevant teams.
 * Ensure that all risk limits are adhered to and assist in implementing new
   limits when necessary.
 * Assist in identifying significant risks within the business and ensuring they
   are transparent to senior management.
 * Remain up-to-date with the current refined products markets.
 * Assist in defining forward curve methodologies for accurate mark-to-market
   and fair value reporting.
 * Support Front Office with the approval of new products and non-standard
   products.
 * Provide information and commentary for the bi-weekly Risk Committee
   meetings. 
 * Support Back Office with month and quarter-end activities as required.
 * Review and approve any relevant changes to the main ETRM system (Endur).
 * Mentor junior members of the team and promote knowledge sharing between
   teams.

Skills and experience required

 * University degree in a numerate discipline (e.g. economics, mathematics, pure
   science, finance, engineering or similar).
 * Relevant experience in a market risk role within a commodity trading company.
 * Strong knowledge of refined products (blending, storage, biofuels, etc) and
   shipping markets.
 * Advanced knowledge of risk metrics such as VaR, stress-testing, scenario
   analysis.
 * Strong knowledge of pricing and hedging of physical activities with the use
   of various derivatives instruments (futures, swaps, options).
 * Strong knowledge of MS Office suite including Excel and VBA. SQL and Python
   would be a strong advantage.
 * Knowledge of the Endur ETRM system would be an advantage.
 * Analytical mindset and strong numerical skills.
 * Strong communication skills, able to communicate concisely with senior
   management in the market risk function and with all stakeholders.
 * Strong organization skills with good attention to detail and the ability to
   work to tight deadlines.
 * Able to mentor junior members.
 * Fluent level of English.

Why ETB?

 * Impactful Work: Join a team that plays a crucial role in Eni’s Net Zero 2050
   strategy, benefiting from Eni’s strong trading position and global
   integration. 
 * Collaborative Culture: Experience a truly multicultural, supportive, and
   dynamic work environment.
 * Career Growth: Rapid learning opportunities with potential for movement
   across teams and international roles.
 * Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a balanced lifestyle with a comprehensive benefits
   package that may include health, well-being, and flexible working options.

How to apply:

 * Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
 * Please upload your CV in English.

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000
employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated
energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the
energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will own the post-sale relationship for a focused portfolio of customers. Customer Ownership and Relationships

Customer Success Rhythm and Value Realization

Risk, Retention, and Growth

• Coordinate cross-functional teams through escalations, ensuring actions, ownership and customer communication remain clear, and reset expectations where needed. 
• Partner with Account Executives and Renewal Specialists on renewal strategy, forecasting and commercial opportunities, including cross-sell and upsell. 

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

• Share customer insight and recurring themes to inform Product, enablement and Customer Success improvements. 
• Contribute to Customer Success initiatives, best-practice sharing and customer success stories.

• Experience owning complex B2B customer relationships in SaaS, enterprise technology, professional services or another solution-oriented environment. 
• Strong customer and commercial judgement, with a track record of driving adoption, retention, value realization and growth.

• Professional fluency in German and English, including the ability to lead customer meetings and executive reviews in German. 

Nice‑to‑have

A Software Developer (Market Setup) takes a trading venue from a signed agreement to the first live trade on our platform, then makes the next venue happen sooner.

What You Own: one venue, stage by stage:

• Scoping. Read the venue's specifications; list what the platform has and what is missing; estimate the setup.Scoping.

• Connectivity. Design it with infra: colocation or proxy, lines, addresses, multicast groups, firewall rules, failover.

• Protocol adaptation. Adapt our market data and order entry connectors to the venue's binary protocol: SBE, FAST, ITCH and OUCH, Eurex ETI and EOBI, LSE native, or the custom binary protocol a venue publishes for itself; sessions, recovery, throttles, reject handling.

• Product and risk parameters feed. Pull the venue's raw product definitions and risk parameters, margin rates, price limits, lot and tick tables, position limits, in whatever form they are published, and deliver them complete to the team that normalizes them; you are their source on what the venue's fields mean.

• Historical data. Convert the venue's archives and captured feeds into our format at volume; validate against live captures.

• Latency tuning. Measure the path with hardware timestamps against the venue's figures and the strategies' budget; tune host placement, NIC and kernel bypass settings, pinning, the connector's hot path, gateway choice; record the baseline for ops.

• Certification. Pass the venue's conformance tests and ours: replay, soak, order-flow scenarios, failover.

• Operations preparation. Write the operating instructions for the desk and ops: sessions and timings, limits, start and stop, failure modes and what to do in each, who to call at the venue. Walk the desk through the first day before it happens.

• Go-live. First live trade, hypercare, handover.

What This Role Is Not:

• Not the core engine: the engine developers in the same team own it; you adapt and assemble.

• Not configuration: a venue needs code, in C++ and Python; an LLM writes much of it, you specify, review and test all of it.

• Not normalization: another team maps the venue's products and risk parameters onto our model; you deliver the raw feed they map from.

• Not 24/7 operations: the desk and ops run the venue after handover; you write what they run.

• Not strategy work: researchers decide what and how to trade; you make the venue tradable.

What We Look For In You:

• Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming in C++

• Understanding of Linux system internals

• Decent level of written and spoken English to work in an international environment

• Performs well in a remote/hybrid team with variable, project-based responsibilities

Nice-to-have: 

• In-depth knowledge and expertise with low latency/real-time development with sub-microsecond latency.

• LockFree containers and thinking pattern

• C programming knowledge (written drivers for Linux system, worked with the core etc.)

• Great challenges with fast feedback loops

• A welcoming group of highly qualified international professionals

• Cutting-edge hardware and technology

• Work remotely from anywhere in the world

• Access any of our global offices anytime

Role Overview

Eutelsat is seeking a Systems Engineer to contribute to the specification and development of the mission control and management systems of IRIS² and future satellite constellations. In satellite communications constellations, the mission control centre refers to the software systems that orchestrate the delivery of requested services by planning payload activities and configuring both space and ground assets to execute the mission.

The role spans a wide range of domains and disciplines as the mission management involves the planning of activities and configuration of satellite gateways, spacecraft payload, transport networks and high-level NG-RAN elements. The mission control centre occupies a central position in the ground segment requiring you to interface closely with service and spacecraft operation teams.

Along with the mission control centre team, you will specify the behaviour and oversee their development and verification of a set of custom software components providing these features. In collaboration with suppliers selected for this project you will design and oversee the implementation and integration of this system.

You will help ensure that the mission planning and resource management functions of the system match the needs of both IRIS² and Eutelsat. • Design integration of Eutelsat’s commercial systems with IRIS² assets.

 Graduate Project Manager

 You will be a key member of the Project delivery team, providing EvoEnergy representation and authority on sites, site activity management as well as hands-on installation support.  Apply now 

 JOB TITLE

 Graduate Project Manager

 SALARY

 Competitive

 TERM

 Full Time

 APPLICATION DEADLINE

 Open

 Apply now 

 About the role:

Candidates should have gained an understanding of project management and the ability to work on-site and to control and manage various trades. You will be a key member of the project delivery team, providing active hands-on installation support, site activity, and installation management, EvoEnergy representation, and authority on sites.

Your knowledge of site management systems will ensure that Project planning and schedules are met through your management of installers and close relationships with other contractors and clients. Over time, your knowledge will develop across our product and service portfolio.

 Key responsibilities:

• In time, you will have full control of a project from inception and plan and programme all activities within a project. As you progress, you will be expected to manage several projects at any one time.

• Prepare method statements, risk assessments, and construction phase plans for client approval.

• Review other contractors’ RAMS for approval.

• Participate and hold internal and external Project meetings, reviews, briefs, and kick-off meetings with clients and contractors.

• Conduct inductions, toolbox talks, health and safety management and inspections of works.

• Point of contact on-site for deliveries and client liaison.

• Authorised person for all quality standards on site.

• Document work undertaken / daily activities and provide a daily activity report.

• Oversee Solar PV, HV/LV, battery storage, and EV charging installations through site management on project builds encompassing electrical work, labour, and civil engineering trades.

• Recognise issues, assess risks, and review any findings with management.

• Inspect work for satisfactory performance by Quality assessing contractors.

• Review and order suitable stocks of supplies and equipment, and request specialist components, fixtures, or fittings as required.

• Rigorously maintain accurate documentation of the Project, spending, associated costs, etc.

• Ensure compliance with health and safety policy and communicate effectively with site teams.

• Investigate complaints and recommend corrective action as necessary to resolve complaints.

• Build and maintain positive working relationships with all stakeholders, including the public.

• Identify and meet personal job-related training and development as required.

 Qualifications:

Essential qualifications (any one of these):

• Projects / Construction Management Qualification or equivalent

Preferred

• Prince 2 or equivalent

• SMSTS

• Electrical qualifications

 Skills Required

Required

• Full UK driving license

Essential

• Experience of running a Project on-site and able to co-ordinate multiple trades

• Experienced site manager with either electrical/roofing/civils background.

• Strong leader that can manage multiple trades on-site.

• Understand site drawings and SLDs.

• Able to work under pressure and deal with reactive situations.

• Good IT skills and documentation control.

• Hardworking, reliable, and flexible with the flexibility to work nationwide and able to stay away from home

Preferred

• Recognised H&S qualifications such as NEBOSH / IOSH or similar

Experience Required:

• 1 year in a similar position, work placement

Behaviors Required:

• Must be able to attend sites and stay away from home periodically.

• Rigorous attention to detail and process-driven work practices. Passion for good service.

• Positive persona, a role model, mentor, and motivator.

• To be honest, professional, and approachable.

• To be objective, offer constructive criticism, and allow others to share opinions.

• High level of self-motivation and determination.

• Personal resilience.

• Ability to work as part of a team and independently.

• Thoughtful and reflective, learning from experience and others, together with a commitment to self-development.

 About the role:

Candidate’s should have a clear understanding and knowledge of Project Management and the ability to work at site and control and manage various trades. As a site-based Project Manager, you will be a key member of the Project delivery team providing active hands-on installation support, site activity and installation management, EvoEnergy representation and authority on sites.

Your knowledge of site management systems will ensure Project planning and schedules are met through your management of installers and close relationships with other contractors and clients. Over time, your knowledge will develop across our portfolio of products/services.

 Key responsibilities:

• You will have full control of a Project from inception and plan and programme all activities within it.

• Prepare Method Statements, Risk Assessments, and Construction Phase Plans.

• Review other contractor RAMS for approval.

• Participate in and hold internal and external project meetings, reviews, briefs, and kick-off meetings with clients and contractors.

• Conduct inductions, toolbox talks, health and safety management, and inspections of all works.

• Point of contact on site for deliveries and client liaison.

• Authorised person for all quality standards on site.

• Document work undertaken/daily activities and provide a daily activity report.

• Oversee solar PV, HV/LV, battery storage, and EV charging installations through site management on project builds encompassing electrical work, labour, and civil engineering trades.

• Recognise issues, assess risks, and review any findings with management.

• Inspect work for satisfactory performance by Quality assessing contractors

• Review and order suitable stocks of supplies and equipment, and request specialist components, fixtures, or fittings as required.

• Maintain accurate documentation of the Project, spending, costs associated, etc.

• Ensure compliance with health and safety policy and communicate effectively with site teams.

• Investigate complaints and recommend corrective action as necessary to resolve complaints.

• Build and maintain positive working relationships with all stakeholders, including the public.

• Identify and meet personal job-related training and development as required.

 Qualifications:

Essential

• Project Management Qualification or equivalent

• SMSTS / SSSTS

• Electrical OR Civil Engineering qualification

• Full UK Driving Licence

Preferred

• Prince 2 or equivalent

• 18th Edition BS7671

 Skills Required

Essential

• Experience in running a Project on-site and the ability to coordinate multiple trades

• Strong leader

• Ability to understand site drawings and SLDs

• Able to work under pressure and deal with reactive situations effectively

• Good IT skills and document control

• Hardworking, reliable, and flexible with the ability to work nationwide and stay away from home

Preferred

• Recognised H&S qualifications such as NEBOSH.

• First aid at work

Experience Required

• Minimum of 3 years in a similar position

Behaviors Required

• Must be able to attend sites and stay away from home periodically

• Rigorous attention to detail and process-driven work practices. Passion for good service

• Positive persona, a role model, mentor, and motivator

• To be honest, professional, and approachable

• To be objective, offer constructive criticism, and allow others to share opinions

• High level of self-motivation and determination.

• Personal resilience.

• Ability to work as part of a team and independently.

• Thoughtful and reflective, learning from experience and others, together with a commitment to self-development.

The Opportunity

You will be joining a small founding engineering team with a domain-specific agentic conveyancing system already in production handling workflows and helping to progress transactions for our lawyers and our clients.

Our focus centres around giving our conveyancers and wider team back the hours they would otherwise spend on behind-the-scenes work that currently makes conveyancing feel slow and opaque to clients: triaging tasks, drafting updates, chasing third parties, checking documents, etc.

This is a greenfield product engineering role with real scope. You’ll have real input on product decisions, working directly with our conveyancers and legal engineering team to understand conveyancing workflows and devise solutions to transaction bottlenecks.

What You Will Do

- Help build Farringdon’s conveyancing agent and contribute to the decisions around how it works — from architecture and AI workflows through to the features we put in front of users.

- Work backwards from the user problem, not the technology. Understand what to build, what not to build, and why. In the AI era, that also means knowing what to delegate to a model, what needs human judgement, and what should not exist at all.

- Contribute to product thinking beyond your technical remit: working with our legal engineers and product leadership to refine problems, explore solutions, and help turn them into working software.

- Experiment with AI tooling to push the boundaries of what is possible today — with enough scepticism to avoid shipping things that are not ready.

- Participate in architecture discussion to improve the quality, maintainability, and security of what we build.

What We Are Looking For

- Experience shipping products or features in early-stage companies. You’ve taken ideas through to production and learned from the process.

- You work with coding agents every day and have moved beyond prompt-and-accept. You decompose problems, delegate execution, and review output with a critical eye. The code is always yours; the agents just let you own more of it.

- Ability to pick up unfamiliar code, systems, and assess AI-generated output. You spot flaws before being told, and you understand why something is wrong.

- Comfort with ambiguity. Early-stage means the spec is often incomplete. You can make good decisions with imperfect information.

- Strong communication: you can make technical decisions and constraints easily understood by a conveyancer and explain the commercial or user rationale behind your decisions.

- Experience designing and shipping LLM-powered features or workflows in production.

- Eager to experiment, learn, and iterate rapidly.

Domain knowledge in legal or property is not required. Curiosity about it is.

The Stack

We're TypeScript and Python end to end. The product is a modern web application; the backend is a set of services exposing typed APIs. At the centre is a conveyancing agent. We run frontier models via API — primarily Anthropic and OpenAI — and the hard, interesting work is everything around the model that turns it into something a conveyancer can actually rely on:

- Tools are the agent's hands. Every capability — reading a case file, drafting an update, chasing a third party, checking a document — is a tool the agent wields. Designing those tools, and deciding what the agent does autonomously versus what it hands back to a human, is the core of the work.

- Context is the real engineering problem. Getting the right information in front of the model at the right moment — across long-running, multi-step transactions — matters more than any single prompt.

- Evals over vibes. We measure whether a change made the agent better or worse before it touches a live transaction, because "it looked fine in testing" is not good enough when someone is buying a house.

- Human-in-the-loop by design. A regulated conveyancer is accountable for every transaction. The agent does the legwork; a human stays in command. The product is built around that division of labour, not around pretending it doesn't exist.

We're a small founding team and the system is young, so the stack is a set of decisions still being made, not a monument to defend. If you have a strong, well-argued case for a different tool or approach, you'll be the one making it. We choose together, and we change our minds when the evidence says so.

Stage 3 : A 60 minute in person meeting with our founder/MD to explore your experience, working style, and alignment with Farringdon’s mission and ways of working.

Careers - Sales Manager

 Apply here

At FG Library, we don’t just supply furniture, we design inspiring library environments that shape communities, support education, and transform spaces across the UK and internationally.

With over 20 years of expertise, we are the UK’s leading designer, manufacturer and supplier of library interiors, working with public sector organisations, schools, universities and local authorities. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a dynamic Sales Manager to join our industry-leading sales team.

The Role

This is far more than a traditional sales position. As a Sales Manager, you’ll be at the heart of exciting, varied projects, from initial conversations through to completed spaces.

You’ll work directly with clients to understand their vision, translate requirements into creative briefs for our in-house designers, and ultimately present and secure the final solution.

Expect a highly varied role with:

• Regular travel to customer meetings, project sites and stakeholders

• Collaboration with our Northampton HQ, Clerkenwell showroom, and four UK manufacturing sites

• Opportunities to shape library spaces across England and Wales.

You’ll inherit a strong, well-established territory, with an existing pipeline and relationships, alongside the freedom to develop new opportunities and grow the region.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and develop sales across public sector, education and healthcare clients

• Manage and grow both existing and dormant accounts

• Generate and respond to new sales leads and enquiries

• Conduct site visits, surveys and client meetings

• Translate client needs into detailed project briefs

• Present tailored design solutions and close sales opportunities

• Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting

• Stay informed on market trends, competitors and product developments

• Contribute to strategic sales and marketing initiatives

What We’re Looking For

Personal Attributes

• Commercially driven with a proactive mindset

• Strong communicator with excellent presentation skills

• Able to listen, interpret and respond to client requirements effectively

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail

• Confident working independently and as part of a team

• Enthusiastic, motivated, and adaptable

Experience

• Proven experience in face-to-face sales (essential)

• Full UK driving licence (essential)

• Experience managing a sales territory and sales pipeline (desirable)

• Background in furniture, interiors, education or public sector sales (desirable)

What We Offer

• Base salary with uncapped commission

• Company car or car allowance

• 28 days holiday (including bank holidays)

• Ongoing training and professional development

• The opportunity to work on meaningful, high-impact projects across the UK

• Part of a wider group structure, with a well established, loyal and experience team in all areas.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 5:30pm

(Flexibility required to meet the demands of the role)

Why Join FG Library?

This is a unique opportunity to step into a creative, consultative sales role where no two days are the same. You’ll be helping shape environments that genuinely make a difference, from schools and universities to public libraries and community spaces.

If you’re driven by building relationships, winning projects, and being part of something tangible and rewarding, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description
Title Enterprise Architect (AMP) 
Department Enterprise Architecture
Location London / Dublin
Reports To Head of AMP Architecture
Level 7
About Fidelity International
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.
As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
About your team
The AMP Enterprise Architecture team is aligned to Enterprise Architecture within FIL Platforms. FIL Platforms brings together accountability for how Fidelity delivers key business capabilities end to end.It owns both day to day performance and ongoing improvement, so work is done once, scaled across the firm, and focused on client and investment outcomes.
Enterprise Architecture serves the needs of Fidelity and its clients, by aligning Business, Process, and Technology strategies to achieve business value. To meet the demands of our current and future business models, Architecture set standards, principles and guidance that prioritises resilient, adaptable, consistent, and cost-effective architecture through process and technology delivery.
About your role 
Purpose of the Role
As an Enterprise Architect for AMP you will provide technical expertise to both the Business and Technology stakeholders in order to direct the investment and transformation from an architecture perspective to help deliver the strategic AMP initiatives in line with the Business, Technology and Data strategies. This includes working with senior business stakeholders to understand and develop their longer term vision, aligning roadmaps to this, developing technology roadmaps that align to both the business vision as well as technology objectives, providing guidance on M&A activity.
Key Responsibilities
Architect
· Identify the current state of how technology is used in the organisation, what technologies are being used and how they are deployed along with the business value the technology is providing.
· Work with stakeholders to understand business drivers and business capabilities (future and current state), and determine corresponding enterprise system designs and change requirements to drive the organisation's targeted customer outcomes.
· Work as part of the team in proposing and gaining agreement for target application architecture for AMP that includes the articulation of a clear transformation roadmap.
· Manage key business stakeholders to achieve consensus agreement to vision and roadmap.
· Ensure that technology solutions to business problems are both pragmatic and supportive of the Global strategic architecture direction.
· Develop architectures that are aligned to business goals, drivers, and strategies; drawing on knowledge of current and possible future business trends, policies and practices and business competition landscape. 
· Understand, advocate and augment the principles of information technology strategies.
Strategize
· Maintain a forward-looking perspective on emerging technology developments and their relevance to Business and Technology Strategies.
· Monitor technology developments to ensure that the organisation is effectively positioned to respond to and leverage opportunities that enhance competitive position through the effective application of technology to the business.
· Develop a roadmap for the evolution of the enterprise application portfolio from future to current state
Lead & Communicate
· Be an advisor to the business and technology leads on AMP architecture and strategy.
· Proactively communicate decisions, roadmap, insight to the technology and business colleagues.
· Proactively input into and provide architectural leadership in governance forums.
Innovate
· Participate in the development of new concepts to support business strategy and provide recommendations to leverage technology for competitive advantage, internal efficiency and improved service.
· Participate in managing vendor relationships on new and existing products, evaluating usefulness and cost of products and making appropriate recommendations.
Collaborate
· Architecture’s success will depend on close collaboration with many other teams in Fidelity, including Engineering, Data, Delivery, Change, Security and Business teams
Deliver
· Design and deliver the transformation of the AMP technology estate, together with the Technology and Business teams. 
· Translate high level business architecture into technology architectures that align to global strategies, simplify the existing architecture, deliver cost saving opportunities and, where appropriate, reusable services.
About you
Experience and Qualifications Required
· Designed & delivered large transformation programme from legacy to new technology
· Extensive experience in the asset management across Investment Management, operations and distribution business
· Experience working with senior business stakeholers
· Skilled in the architecture, design and implementation of complex technology solutions
· Strong communication skills with different types and levels of stakeholders both internal and external.
· Effective leadership skills including negotiation, conflict resolution, influencing, bridge-building and political astuteness
· Hands-on experience managing end-to-end systems development from customer specifications through to deployment
· Experience of managing technology driven business process change
· The ability to convey complex, abstract technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
· A good understanding of financial markets, products and organisations
· Excellent and resourceful problem-solving skills, adaptable with a willingness to learn
· Proactive and self-organising with a “can-do” approach
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

The Analyst, Live Service is responsible for providing pre-trade and post-trade operational support. Reporting to the Manager, Live Service, this is a high-impact, market-facing role that sits at the heart of the LSE 24/5 operating model, helping ensure the smooth operation of extended-hours trading. The role plays a critical part in maintaining market integrity and resilience through activities such as stock suspensions, trading cycle interventions, order deletions, and real-time market monitoring.

The Live Service Team delivers real-time operational support and middle-office services across the London Stock Exchange and Turquoise markets. Working at the center of a dynamic trading environment, the team collaborates closely with Sales, Product, Technology, exchange and clearing members, and CCPs to support market operations and drive strategic business and product initiatives.

The Live Service Market Operations team forms part of Market Supervision, which oversees the efficient, compliant, and resilient operation of LSEG markets, including LSE and Turquoise venues. Through real-time and post-trade surveillance, operational oversight, incident management, and market support, the team plays a key role in enabling the successful delivery of the LSE 24/5 operating model and supporting the evolution of modern market infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
• Support extended-hours trading operations as part of the LSE 24/5 operating model, handling and resolving live-service and post-trade issues to ensure market stability, operational resilience, and high-quality client service.
• Act as an operational escalation point for market events and incidents, coordinating with business, technology, and external partners to drive timely resolution and minimize market impact.
• Undertake market recovery actions for the LSE 24/5 market, including alternative site recovery, late market and manual market start-ups, trading halts and resumptions, instrument suspensions and resumptions, and partition recovery.
• Provide real-time operational support for market activities across the LSE 24/5 market.
• Perform structured shift handovers and maintain operational continuity across regional teams supporting the LSE 24/5 market.
• Identify and minimize risks within pre-trade and post-trade operations by reviewing risk indicators and tracking actions to remediate control gaps.
• Lead and maintain real-time static and multifaceted instrument and reference data.
• Act as the first-line operational support contact for client queries, issues, and disputes.
• Collaborate optimally across products, teams, and business areas to deliver robust services and support continuous improvement initiatives.
• Provide weekend and bank holiday coverage as the need arises.
• Partner with Project Managers, Technology, and Sales/Trading teams on system enhancements and development initiatives.
• Assist in the resolution of technical and production issues and incidents.
• Investigate process failures and implement corrective actions.
• Participate in internal projects focused on process improvement and industry or regulatory change.
• Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement.

This role requires shift work to support overnight trading sessions - 16:00 - 00:00 and 23:30 - 07:30.

Key Behaviours
Integrity
• Delivers on promises and builds trust through responsible actions.
• Takes ownership of delivery and empowers others to do the same.
Partnership
• Forges long-term relationships with internal and external partners, working together to address evolving needs and deliver strategic outcomes.
• Customer-centric.
• Builds deep connections with customers, partners, and colleagues.
• Collaborates across boundaries.
Change
• Embraces change and combines human ingenuity, technology, risk management, and insight to create products and services that lead and shape the industry.
• Is curious and challenges the status quo.
• Combines creativity with technology to invent new possibilities.
• Has a growth mindset.
• Finds opportunities in complexity and uncertainty.
Excellence
• Tailors oral and written communication to the needs of the audience.
• Is proactive and demonstrates initiative.
• Prioritises activities according to business and operational needs.
• Analyses issues to identify appropriate solutions and utilises available resources and toolsets to investigate and resolve problems.

Key Skills

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to work to deadlines under pressure.
• Ability to work flexibly across extended trading hours.
• Experience working in professional, client-focused environments where detailed processes and procedures must be followed.
• Confident phenomenal teammate with strong interpersonal skills and a can-do attitude.
