job_description:
About K3 Advisory Group
K3 Advisory Group is a private equity backed advisory and professional services group providing expert advisory across Business Sales, Tax, Restructuring, Technology Solutions, and Financial Services.
Our Data Protection function sits within Group Legal and is responsible for delivering and maintaining the Group's data protection framework across all Group businesses.

Role overview
We are looking for a Data Protection Executive to provide fixed-term cover for a period of maternity leave (9-month FTC). This is a practical, junior-to-mid-level role supporting the Group Data Protection Officer (DPO) and the wider Legal and Data Protection team by managing core privacy workflows across the Group.
The post-holder will own the day-to-day operation of key data protection processes — including DPIAs, data subject rights requests, personal data breach triage, supplier and data processing agreement reviews, and governance reporting. The role operates with a degree of autonomy over process and workflow, escalating legal, high-risk, contentious and regulated-business matters to the Group DPO or Legal for decision.

Key responsibilities
DPIAs and privacy by design
• Operate the DPIA screening process and maintain the central DPIA register

• Review screening questionnaires and identify when a full DPIA is required

• Facilitate assessments with project and business teams, documenting processing, necessity and proportionality, risks, mitigations, owners and review dates

• Escalate high residual risk, novel processing, international transfers, AI use, special-category data and proposed prior consultations to the Group DPO

Data subject rights requests
• Log, acknowledge and coordinate DSARs and other rights requests

• Agree search scope with relevant business areas, maintain response timetables and track disclosure materials

• Support the review, redaction and preparation of responses

Personal data breaches
• Receive and triage incidents promptly

• Coordinate containment, fact gathering, investigation records and root-cause analysis

• Maintain the breach register and notification timetable

Supplier and DPA reviews
• Conduct first-pass reviews of data processing agreements and supplier privacy due diligence

• Check core Article 28 UK GDPR requirements, including security evidence, sub-processors, international transfers, breach assistance, audit rights and exit arrangements

Governance, advisory and awareness
• Support ROPA, data mapping, policy updates and privacy champion engagement

• Act as point of contact for routine operational data protection queries from the Group's non-regulated businesses

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and propose updates to templates and processes for Group DPO approval

Skills & experience
Essential
• 1–3 years' practical data protection, compliance, legal operations or privacy experience

• Hands-on experience handling or materially supporting DPIAs, DSARs, breach logs or supplier privacy due diligence

• Working knowledge of the UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, PECR and the current UK data protection regime

• Strong drafting, organisation, stakeholder management and document-review skills

• Ability to manage deadlines, sensitive information and competing requests across multiple businesses, and maintain registers, trackers, MI and audit evidence

Desirable
• IAPP CIPP/E, CIPM, BCS or equivalent privacy qualification (or active progress towards one)

• Experience in professional services, financial services or a multi-entity group

• Exposure to DPA negotiation, international transfers, AI governance or privacy-by-design reviews

• Familiarity with SharePoint, workflow tools and data-mapping or privacy-management platforms

What we offer
• Negotiable basic salary pro rated £30,000 - £40,000 depending on experience

• A collaborative, purpose-driven working environment within a growing Group

• Exposure to a broad range of data protection matters across multiple business lines

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced legal and compliance professionals

• Hybrid or fully remote and flexible working arrangements

#### AI Engineers in Oxford/Remote

AI Engineers develop the intelligence systems that animate spatial artifacts, collaborating closely with Architectural Assistants and Computational Designers. This work involves integrating machine learning models, sensor fusion, and real-time adaptation algorithms, all while considering the practical constraints faced by Operations Managers and Business Managers. Embedded AI plays a crucial role in enhancing physical expression, requiring fluency in both the theoretical foundations of artificial intelligence and the hands-on experience needed for deploying intelligence in objects that move, sense, and respond in real space. This research involves various fields such as kinematics, control systems, actuator design, and human–robot interaction, reimagined for environments rather than isolated machines. The focus is on distributed robotics, soft robotics, and the innovative concept that movement itself can serve as a form of spatial intelligence, engaging not only AI Engineers and Computational Designers but also Architectural Assistants and Business Managers in the design process. Their work bridges digital modeling and physical fabrication—developing the computational frameworks that enable artifacts to adapt and evolve. This role requires thinking algorithmically while understanding material constraints, fabrication processes, and how code becomes form, which is essential for Architectural Assistants, Research Assistants, and Robotic Fabrication Assistants. We’re an independent games studio best known for creating Phasmophobia, enjoyed by millions of players worldwide. Our team is passionate, creative, and collaborative and we’re looking for someone equally enthusiastic about games to join our growing team.

We’re a small but fast growing, friendly team that values creativity, openness, and personal growth. Whether you’re helping various departments or talking about your favourite horror game, you’ll be part of a supportive environment where passion and curiosity are celebrated. You’ll be joining a small but ambitious team where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your development truly matters.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are important to how we work together every day. We aim to build a team with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great games start with an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow, and succeed. Applications from all qualified candidates are encouraged. Equal opportunities are provided throughout our recruitment and employment practices.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We'll work with you to understand your needs and provide appropriate support wherever reasonably practicable.

About the role:
• We are looking for an organised and experienced Lead Game Designer to lead the design of content updates for Phasmophobia. You will work closely with the Game Director to translate the overall creative vision into clear, cohesive gameplay experiences, systems, and features.
• You will be responsible for driving the design process across the development team, ensuring features are well-defined, appropriately scoped, and delivered to a consistently high standard. Alongside owning key areas of design yourself, you will support and guide other designers, helping establish strong design practices, documentation standards, and workflows across the studio.
• You will collaborate closely with every development team to ensure gameplay features meet the creative vision. This role is ideal for an experienced designer who combines strong hands-on design skills with leadership, communication, and the ability to provide clear direction within a fast-paced, iterative live game environment.

This role is hybrid based at our office in Southampton. At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Work closely with the Game Director to translate the creative direction into detailed gameplay features, mechanics, systems, and content.
• Lead the game design discipline, providing direction, support, and feedback to other designers.
• Take ownership of the overall quality, consistency, and clarity of game design across updates.
• Own key gameplay features and systems from initial concept through implementation, iteration, balancing, and release.
• Review and provide feedback on design work to ensure it aligns with the game's creative direction and established design principles.
• Establish and maintain clear design processes, documentation standards, and best practices across the design team.
• Create and oversee clear, detailed, and actionable design documentation for cross-discipline teams.
• Break high-level creative direction into actionable design work and help distribute design ownership across the team.
• Mentor and support designers, helping them develop their design skills, decision-making, ownership, and understanding of Phasmophobia.
• Identify gameplay, scope, UX, and implementation risks early and work proactively with stakeholders to resolve them.
• Collaborate closely with production to ensure design work is appropriately prioritised, scoped, and aligned with project milestones.
• Work closely with programmers to improve designer workflows, tools, pipelines, and the ability for designers to implement and iterate on content independently.
• Confidently use Unity Editor tools to tune gameplay, implement content, prototype ideas, and iterate on features hands-on.
• Facilitate design reviews and help resolve design problems or conflicting requirements between disciplines.
• Gather and interpret internal, community, and gameplay feedback to improve player experience, gameplay readability, balance, and feature quality.
• Play and test new updates regularly, ensuring the design team has a strong understanding of the game as a whole and that features meet gameplay, usability, and quality expectations.
• Help identify opportunities to improve existing gameplay systems and the overall player experience

Requirements:
• Expert understanding of Phasmophobia and a passion for horror and puzzle games.
• Previous experience as a Lead Game Designer or equivalent within a large development team.
• At least 1 shipped PC or Console game as a credited Game Designer, Senior Game Designer, Lead Game Designer, Game Director or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of gameplay design work.
• Significant professional game design experience with a strong understanding of the complete feature development process.
• Experience leading, mentoring, or providing design direction to other designers.
• Strong experience designing multiplayer, horror, survival, or atmospheric gameplay systems.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to provide clear design direction across multiple disciplines.
• Strong understanding of gameplay systems, balancing, progression, pacing and player experience.
• Experience taking high-level creative direction and developing it into detailed, actionable designs.
• Strong experience writing, reviewing, and maintaining design documentation.
• Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to make design decisions.
• A collaborative mindset and confidence working closely with discipline leads, production, and senior stakeholders.
• Eligibility to work in the UK.

Nice to Have:
• Experience working on live-service or regularly updated games.
• Experience working on puzzle or investigation mechanics.
• Experience working on a VR game.
• Strong experience using Unity Editor.
• Experience prototyping gameplay features directly within a game engine.

We’re an independent games studio best known for creating Phasmophobia, enjoyed by millions of players worldwide. Our team is passionate, creative, and collaborative and we’re looking for someone equally enthusiastic about games to join our growing team.

About the role:
We are looking for an organised and experienced Senior Game Designer to help define and expand content updates for Phasmophobia. You will work closely with the Game Director to turn creative direction into fully realised gameplay features and systems, taking them from concept through to release.

You will take ownership of gameplay experiences across live updates, helping shape content played by millions of players worldwide. As a senior member of the team, you’ll collaborate closely with art, audio, narrative, production, QA, and programming to ensure features deliver on gameplay quality, atmosphere, and technical feasibility.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, iterative live-service environment and is passionate about multiplayer horror game design.

This role is hybrid based at our office in Southampton. At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Work closely with the Game Director to develop and expand gameplay features, mechanics, and systems.
• Take ownership of feature design from concept through implementation, iteration, and release.
• Create and maintain clear, detailed, and actionable design documentation for cross-discipline teams.
• Flesh out gameplay systems, mechanics, progression, balancing, UX flows, edge cases, and technical considerations.
• Identify gameplay, scope, UX, and implementation risks early and work proactively with stakeholders to resolve them.
• Collaborate with production to ensure design work aligns with project scope, priorities, and milestone expectations.
• Work closely with programmers to improve designer workflows, tools, and pipelines.
• Confidently use Unity Editor tools to tune gameplay, implement content, and iterate on features hands-on.
• Collaborate with departmental stakeholders to ensure features are achievable within technical and production constraints.
• Gather and interpret internal and community feedback to improve player experience, gameplay readability, and feature quality.
• Play and test new updates regularly to ensure features meet gameplay, usability, and quality expectations.
Requirements:
• At least 1 shipped PC or Console game as a credited Game Designer with a strong portfolio.
• Strong experience designing multiplayer, co-op, horror, survival, or atmospheric gameplay systems.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative development environment.
• Strong understanding of gameplay systems, balancing, progression, pacing, and player psychology.
• Experience writing and maintaining detailed design documentation.
• A collaborative mindset and confidence working across multiple disciplines.
• Expert understanding of Phasmophobia and a passion for horror games.
• Ability to take ownership of features and drive them through iteration and delivery.
• Automatically have the right to work in the UK.
Nice To Have:
• Experience working on live-service or regularly updated games.
• Experience working on a VR game.
• Experience using Unity Editor.
• Experience with technical implementation, scripting, or designer tooling workflows.
• Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar development tools.
• Experience analysing player feedback, telemetry, or gameplay metrics.

• Work directly inside Unity to implement, test or iterate UI layouts where required.
• Review existing systems and identify opportunities for UX improvements and quality-of-life features.

• Familiarity with player telemetry and usability testing workflows.
• Experience designing tutorials and initial player onboarding.

About the role:
As Technical Director, you will own the studio-wide technical direction at Kinetic Games, working closely with the Game Director, Development Director, Programming Leads and other discipline leadership.
You will provide technical oversight across projects, ensure engineering teams are set up to succeed, identify and manage technical risks, and help establish the standards and practices required as the studio continues to scale.
This is not purely an architectural or advisory position. We are looking for someone who remains technically credible and actively engaged with development, able to investigate difficult problems, review technical solutions and provide practical guidance when teams need support.
You will also play an important role in shaping our longer-term technology strategy, including evaluating engines, platforms, tools and development practices for Phasmophobia.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Define and maintain the studio's overall technical vision and strategy.
• Provide technical leadership to ensure projects have appropriate architecture, engineering standards and technical plans.
• Provide oversight of major technical decisions and ensure solutions support long-term maintainability and scalability.
• Identify technical risks early and work with teams to resolve them before they impact development.
• Maintain a strong understanding of the technical health of Phasmophobia.
• Establish engineering standards, development practices and technical review processes.
• Review and challenge major architectural decisions where appropriate.
• Support Programming Leads and senior engineers with complex technical problems.
• Ensure performance, stability, networking, platform requirements and scalability are considered throughout development.
• Work across disciplines to resolve technical dependencies and ensure technology supports design, art, audio, QA and production requirements.
• Partner with Production and Development leadership when making decisions around scope, technical investment and delivery.
• Help determine when technical debt should be addressed and ensure it does not create unacceptable long-term risk.
• Evaluate new technologies, engines, middleware, tools and workflows where they could improve development.
• Help define the technical direction of future Kinetic Games projects.
• Contribute to engineering recruitment, team structure and workforce planning.
• Help develop Programming Leads while building a strong engineering culture across the studio.
• Ensure strong security and best practices are used for back-end multiplayer services.
Requirements:
• Significant professional game development experience, including experience in a senior technical leadership role.
• Experience shipping commercially released games on PC and console.
• Strong hands-on programming and software engineering knowledge.
• Strong understanding of modern game architecture and development pipelines.
• Strong knowledge of areas such as performance, memory, rendering, networking, build systems, tools and platform development.
• Ability to understand unfamiliar technical systems quickly and challenge technical decisions constructively.
• Experience providing technical direction across multiple teams or large multidisciplinary projects.
• Experience working effectively with Programming Leads, Principal Engineers and other senior technical staff.
• Strong understanding of the relationship between engineering decisions, production constraints and game quality.
• Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable making difficult technical decisions and taking accountability for their outcomes.
Desirable Experience
• Experience working on multiplayer and live service games.
• Experience supporting a successful live game.
• Experience developing games across PC and current generation consoles (PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo platforms).
• Experience with Unity and/or Unreal Engine.

## Software Engineer - 3D Data Visualisation

### Role & Requirements

We are looking for software engineers to join our development team building a next-gen real-time 3d data visualisation and presentation application that runs entirely in the browser.

Experience designing and architecting large web applications would be ideal. A background in creating games or interactive visual applications (web or native) would be of particular interest.

We primarily use web technologies (TypeScript, React, WebGPU and WGSL, Node/Bun Postgres, AWS), but the development process is more akin to building a game or graphics application than a typical web app. Whilst we leverage AI coding tools, strong code fluency and transferable experience are still essential. Specific skills like WebGPU and shader programming can be learnt on the job.

There is a lot of emphasis on visual aesthetics and user experience, as well as technical best-practices and software engineering craftsmanship. We are looking for people who embrace the full spectrum of product development and self-improvement.

You should be willing to help drive and specify new feature development, contribute ideas, and be up for solving new problems that working at the cutting edge can throw at you.

Good communication and team-working skills are essential and an enthusiasm to share knowledge with the rest of the team.

_We love a good demo!_ 
Previous examples of work such as production sites, personal projects, open-source contributions, or video demos are great to see if possible.

- This is a full-time role at 35 hours per week with flexible working hours
- A hybrid work routine where most people work from home on Wednesday and Friday
- We trust people to work to a schedule that best suits them as long as there is appropriate overlap with the rest of the team
- 34 holidays per year (including public holidays taken at any time)
- Competitive salary based on experience and a future opportunity to share in the success of the company
- Nest pension scheme with 5% company contributions
- Latest MacBook Pro (with external 4k screen in the office)
- Individual annual budget for professional development like conference trips or training courses
- Time and support for preparing and presenting at local meet-ups
- A visit to the head office in Munich
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Secure bike storage and on site showers
- Fruit and snacks plus a stocked fridge for social drinks
- A very nice top floor office on the corner of St Andrew Square in the city centre
- Only two minutes walk from the bus, trams and Waverley station

The team has a diverse mix of skills with backgrounds in literature, music, engineering, maths, physics and computer science. As life-long learners we have a broad range of interests beyond our own specialisms.

We aim to foster an intellectually stimulating environment with an inclusive culture. We put emphasis on the craft of our work and sharing of knowledge within the team to ensure that we can all grow and improve together. We would love for you to contribute to that!

### Interview Process

1. An initial online video call (30 mins) with our project manager to understand a bit more about you and your interest in the role
2. A face-to-face interview (1 hour) to learn more about your experience, interests and topics that get you excited. It is a chance for you to see our fantastic office space, meet some of the team, learn more about the company and get a secret demo of our projects.
3. Following a successful discussion, we would invite you for an in-person technical session (2 hours) back in the office. The session would be split into three sections to assess technical proficiency at both code and conceptual levels, plus higher level approaches towards planning feature development along with one of the product owners.

Job Title: Senior Design Engineer
Department: Engineering Location: Stroud
Direct Reports: None Reports to: Product Design Manager
Dimensions: Design inputs and solutions
Date Created: November 2023 Review Date: April 2026
Job
Purpose
• To work as part of the Design Engineering Team; interpreting customer specifications to
configure existing products or create new product designs, creating models and drawings
using 3D CAD, creating Bills of Material and documentation to support business functions.

Overseeing engineering design tasks related to customer enquiries to ensure delivery of
work packages to the required quality, delivery and cost.

Key Accountabilities
• Interpret customer requirements / specifications and translate into engineered product
design, aligning with both technical & commercial requirements.

• Ensure tasks are planned & prioritised to support on-time delivery to project requirements.

• Produce detailed designs for new products using 3D CAD.

• Produce 3D Models, Engineering Drawings, and BOMs to allow manufacture of components.

• Solve mechanical Engineering problems and be able to demonstrate a clear and logical
methodology.

• Perform & document Engineering calculations to allow colleagues and third-parties to
interpret and validate the results.

• Perform FEA analysis where necessary to assess and document suitability of new designs /
design modifications.

• Analyse & document test data to verify compliance to specification requirements.

• Compile professional engineering documents for distribution internally and to the customer,
discussing and presenting report findings when necessary.

• To ensure designs are accurate and conform to required design codes (API, ISO, PED,
ASME VIII) and customer specifications.

• Utilise DFM / DFA methodologies in all design work.

• Participate in Continuous Improvement initiatives, including problem-solving to enhance
existing products and processes.

• Checking of Drawings and B.O.M.’s.

• Support the transition of new products into Production.

• Input into Engineering strategy, policies & procedures to drive company direction.

• Act as a mentor to other Engineers within the business.

• Support the Engineering department at a variety of meetings both internally and occasionally
at Customer sites, providing Engineering support and advice as appropriate.

• Deputise for the Principal Engineer when required.

• Other Engineering tasks as delegated by the Product Design Manager.

• Business Travel will be required from time to time.

Expertise
• A recognised qualification in Mechanical Engineering.

• Experienced user of 3D CAD for design and drafting.

• Conceptual & detailed design skills.

• Design for Manufacture & Assembly.

• Experience of designing high pressure equipment to industry standards.

• Ability to produce detailed design calculations and reports.

• Experienced in the use of Finite Element Analysis.

• An understanding of materials and their applications, metals in particular.

• Familiarity in the use of Geometrical Design and Tolerancing (GD&T).

• To have a pro-active attitude and be able to demonstrate good analytical and problem-
solving skills.

• Knowledge of using an MRP System (e.g. Visual, Syteline) to produce BOM’s.

• Experience of using a Quality management system database.

• Work to and promote high standards of quality, with a strong focus on safety.

• Knowledge of technical software such as MathCAD and LabView.

• A positive approach with good interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently or as
part of a team.

• The ability to plan your own activities within a project and be adaptable to changing priorities
and demanding deadlines.

• Proficient in the use of MS Office Products, particularly Excel.

Impact
Define and present the overall Engineered design solution being offered, including specific details,
which meet all industry standards and customer requirements / specifications.

Act as a key technical representative for the business and be able to clearly demonstrate intricate
knowledge of design specifics and technical requirements.

Resource
Required to manage own time and liaise with other stakeholders as appropriate to maximise outputs,
efficiencies, stakeholders’ satisfaction, and business reputation.

Responsible (along with other colleagues in the department) for the effective updating/upkeep of the
design database, to ensure records are upheld and 100% accurate.

Complexity
Interpret technical specifications, perform Engineering calculations & data analysis, and undertake
direct research into a range of subjects and areas, to ensure all aspects of product design / offering
comply with industry and customer requirements.

Are you looking for a change of role and are wondering if a move into FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) design might be for you? Leonardo provides a route to develop your existing skills in our on-site FPGA Academy, to allow you to become a full-time Senior FPGA / Firmware Engineer. You’ll then apply your talents to a range of cutting edge designs in our world class Radar and Advanced Targeting Systems (RATS) team.

About the FPGA Academy
The FPGA Academy is a 16‑week structured training and development programme designed for engineers with transferable technical skill sets (such as electronic engineering, embedded software, or systems engineering) who wish to transition into FPGA / Firmware Engineering.
The Academy provides focused technical training, mentored practical exercises, and hands‑on project work. On successful completion, engineers are deployed across a range of complex design projects, contributing to real systems alongside experienced FPGA and Electronics engineers.
This programme is not intended for absolute beginners; it is aimed at capable engineers with strong fundamentals and proven problem‑solving ability who can quickly adapt and progress.

About the Role
As an FPGA Academy Engineer, you will re-skill into a FPGA / Firmware engineering role and apply your existing engineering and coding experience to the design, implementation, and verification of complex electronic systems. You will learn how to translate requirements into robust FPGA-based solutions and work within established engineering processes suitable for high‑reliability and mission‑critical applications.

What You’ll Do
During the Academy, and following deployment, you will:
• Undertake a structured 16‑week FPGA training programme combining:

• Practical labs

• Mentored design exercises

• Online training material and self-led research

• Apply systems thinking to hardware design challenges

• Post training deployment into established engineering teams

Once you have completed the Academy, as a FPGA / Firmware Engineer, you will be responsible for (with support appropriate to your development stage):
• Hardware requirements, capture and management

• Concept development for complex functions and systems

• FPGA design, implementation, and analysis

• Applying verification techniques using VHDL or SystemVerilog, with exposure to UVM where applicable

• Production of material for design reviews

• Development of test planning, integration, and design verification activities

• Ensuring all firmware designs comply with the company firmware development process

• Working with FPGA technologies and tools from AMD, Altera, or Microchip

What you’ll bring
• A degree (BSc, BEng, MEng, MSc, PhD, EngD) in Electrical & Electronic Engineering (preferred) or a related science (e.g. Physics)

• Coding experience, such as: Embedded C / C++, Python / scripting languages, Low‑level or real‑time software, algorithmic or systems‑level programming

• Proven engineering problem‑solving experience, demonstrated through academic projects, industrial experience or personal / independent engineering work

• Strong digital engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly

Housing is a human industry. People become letting agents and property managers to look after residents, then spend their days chasing leads and copying data between systems. Growing a portfolio has always meant hiring more people to do the admin.

Lette is building the AI-native operating system for rental operators, from first enquiry to signed lease and from move-in to renewal. Rental housing is a huge industry still run on manual work, and few problems suit AI agents better: high-volume, multi-channel and rule-bound, with a real resident on the other end of every decision.

**What you'll be doing**

You'll be Lette's first product manager, working directly with the founders, engineering, design, customer ops and sales. This is a senior IC role: no team to inherit, no product ops function and no playbook yet. Rather than writing user stories, managing people or project managing delivery, your focus will be on:

- Owning a product area and deciding what gets built, in what order, and why

- Shipping product that operators actually adopt, measured in outcomes and revenue, not features shipped

- Setting the product standard at Lette, including the bar every future PM is hired against

**Here are some examples of what you'll be doing:**

- **Getting close to operators.** Spending real time with leasing teams and property managers, on site and on calls. Not a week goes by without you talking to a customer.

- **Shipping personally.** Prototyping, scoping and making the call yourself, then working with engineering and design to get it into operators' hands.

- **Turning signal into product.** Combining product vision with live customer feedback and usage data to decide what to build next, and what not to.

- **Connecting product to the rest of Lette.** Making sure customer ops and sales know what's shipping, why it matters and how to sell it.

- **Shaping how we work.** Defining intake, prioritisation and release rhythm as we scale. None of it is fixed yet.

**What a good fit looks like**

- **You've done it before.** 5+ years in product, with at least two owning an area end to end in B2B SaaS. You have outcomes to show us. Experience in proptech or vertical SaaS with operational buyers is a plus.

- **You have a founder mindset.** Ideally you've founded a company before. At minimum, you've been an early hire at a startup.

- **You're a passionate builder.** You build in your spare time and can show us several side projects. You're genuinely energised by how fast technology is moving: you keep up with what's new and you get your hands on it early.

- **You understand AI products.** You've shipped AI-powered products and have a clear view of where they work and where they don't.

- **You're a systems thinker.** Complex operational workflows, integrations and messy real-world data don't scare you.

- **You're commercially wired.** You understand who you're solving for and what it's worth to them.

- **You own your work.** You take responsibility, close open loops and speak up. Your writing is short, clear and decisive.

**Why us?**

This is a rare chance to define product at a fast-growing, AI-native company from the ground up. Lette already powers live operations for institutional operators across Ireland and the UK, and won Emerging PropTech of the Year (Business Post, 2026).

**What you'll get:**

- Founding-level equity

- Highly competitive salary depending on experience

- Remote within Ireland or the UK, with frequent travel to our product development HQ in Dublin and commercial HQ in London.

- 35 days paid leave (incl. Bank Holidays)

- Quarterly team off-sites to connect, build and reset

We’re looking for an experienced, practical Software Developer to join our small, friendly development team. Permanent, full-time, remote (UK) with regular travel to Bristol.

Who We Are

LevelTech is the technology company behind SquashLevels and PadelLevels, two platforms helping racket sports players understand their level, track their progress, find better matches and get more from the sports they play.

SquashLevels is well established in the global squash community, while PadelLevels is growing rapidly as we bring the same approach to padel. Other racket sports are in the pipeline.

Our team develops and supports both platforms, combining player ratings, match data, competitions, integrations, mobile apps and community features.

The Role

First and foremost, we want someone who is a good software developer: someone who understands how modern web applications work, writes clear and maintainable code, solves problems sensibly and takes responsibility for what they build.

You’ll probably have an area where you are strongest, but we’re particularly interested in people who are comfortable contributing across different parts of a product when needed.

We’re a small team, so adaptability and sound technical judgement are more important to us than fitting neatly into a front-end or back-end box.

What You’ll Be Working On

- Front-end and user interface development
- Back-end development, APIs and databases
- External partner platform integrations
- Mobile app development and ongoing improvements
- Data analysis, algorithms and data science
- User experience and product usability
- Internal tools, automation and testing
- Performance, reliability and escalated technical issues

We operate a product-led environment where UX and usability are central to the development process. Ideally, you have worked closely with product/UX designers and understand how to turn designs and user journeys into polished, intuitive features.

Our support team handles day-to-day customer support, but our developers support them on any escalated technical issues. We value that connection with real users and the insight it provides into how our products are actually being used.

What We’re Looking For

- 3+ years of commercial software development experience
- Strong experience developing web-based applications or platforms
- Good understanding of web architecture, APIs, databases and performance
- Clear, maintainable and well-structured coding practices
- Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to getting useful things delivered
- Experience with Git and GitHub or similar version control tools
- Comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies and working outside your main area of expertise when needed
- Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your work
- A strong focus on delivering a high-quality experience for users
- Good team player, particularly important in a remote working environment

Useful Experience

Our current technology includes:

- PHP
- Laravel
- JavaScript / TypeScript
- HTML and CSS/SASS
- Vue.js
- Node.js / NPM
- MySQL/MariaDB
- REST APIs
- Capacitor

Experience in mobile development, data science, statistics, algorithms, cloud infrastructure, DevOps or automated testing would also be useful.

We use Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development. AI helps experienced developers work faster; developers remain responsible for their code. Experience with these tools is useful, but strong software engineering experience and judgement are more important.

About You

- Like understanding the whole product rather than only your individual part of it
- Enjoy solving real problems and seeing your work reach users
- Are curious and comfortable picking up new technologies when needed
- Can make sensible technical decisions without over-engineering
- Enjoy having ownership and responsibility for what you build
- Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
- Enjoy working within a small, accountable team

An interest in sport, particularly racket sports, would be a real advantage. Being an active player can make it easier to understand the problems our products are trying to solve, although it isn’t essential.

Location and Terms

The role is remote, but LevelTech is a UK business with the team centred around Bristol. Bristol or nearby is preferred; remote UK-based candidates with frequent travel to Bristol will also be considered for exceptional candidates.

We value spending some time together in person for planning, problem solving and keeping the team connected, so we expect the successful candidate to be able to travel to Bristol regularly.

Permanent, full-time, with a 3-month probationary period.

Sharing in Our Success

For the right person with a long-term view, there may be the opportunity to receive shares in the company and benefit from our future success.

We're hiring an experienced security practitioner to lead this work at the boundary between AI safety and security. This is an opportunity to help shape a developing area of AI safety through security practice. You will combine technical investigation with careful analysis and clear writing, working closely with our established Security team, researchers and engineers to turn findings into implemented improvements.

You will bring security depth and develop your understanding of model capabilities, evaluations and safeguards through that work. Prior experience in AI safety is welcome, but not required.

What You'll Be Building

• Threat-model consequential systems and capabilities. Investigate how dangerous misuse or compromise could occur across models, deployed services and scientific workflows. Identify the relevant actors, access routes and failure paths, and the protections that could interrupt them.

• Test the assumptions behind our defenses. Examine architectures, code, configurations and operational evidence. Run focused adversarial tests, build prototypes and investigate weaknesses, including situations where several protections depend on the same underlying system.

• Shape the protections needed for safe deployment. Turn dangerous-capability assessments into concrete security requirements. Assess how compromise of models, sensitive assets or supporting systems changes the safety assessment, drawing on personnel, physical and other security specialists where relevant.

• Make evidence-based recommendations. Define what evidence would demonstrate that important controls and safeguards work together. Combine findings from model evaluations and security testing, explain the remaining uncertainty, and recommend improvements or conditions for use.

• Carry findings through to practical improvements. Work with Security, Safety and engineering owners to prioritize changes, specify acceptance criteria and verify the results. Make clear recommendations about which gaps require attention first and why.

• Anticipate what more capable systems will require. Identify where changes in capability, access or deployment call for stronger protections. Help teams plan security work with long lead times, and update assessments as systems change or new evidence emerges.

• Develop methods that others can use. Turn your investigations into clear threat models, assessment methods and technical guidance. Help Safety and Security colleagues apply the approach to new problems and build a shared understanding of the evidence behind decisions.

- Work within the established component library and UI patterns, extending them properly rather than working around them
- Write tests at unit, integration and end-to-end level, and argue for the coverage that matters
- Consider performance and accessibility in your own code and deal with the obvious problems before review
- Identify and raise frontend technical debt clearly, with a view on what it is costing

Delivery

- Plan and deliver frontend work end to end, managing your own time and raising risks early

- Keep delivery moving when designs or requirements are unsettled, while chasing the clarity you need

Impact

- Help junior engineers get better through informal mentoring on day-to-day frontend questions
- Raise process improvements and follow them through when you take ownership
- Share what works from your own delivery so the team picks it up rather than solving the same problem again

Communication

- Adapt how you communicate to the audience, with technical detail for engineers and clear summaries for product and stakeholders
- Contribute substantively to design reviews
- Give specific, useful feedback in code review, and take it the same way
- Work directly with product and design, and raise disagreements early and professionally rather than letting them sit
- Write documentation other people can pick up and use without coming back to you

AI and Innovation

- Use AI to accelerate delivery without transferring the cost to reviewers or to long-term maintainability

job_description:
At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.

Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.

You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.

This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.

• 

Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Own the simulator

• Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.

• Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.

• Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.

• Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.

• Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.

Tune and close the sim2real gap

• Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.

• Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.

• Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.

• Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.

• Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator

Grow into reinforcement learning

• Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.

• Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.

• Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.

• Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.

• Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.

• Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.

Qualifications

• A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.

• Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).

• Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.

• Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.

• Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.

• Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.

• Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.

Role Overview 

The D365 Platform Manager is the end to end owner of Logicor's Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations service across all live countries. The role owns all three critical horizons: keeping the service running, keeping it maintained and compliant, and driving continuous improvement. Architecture and technical direction sit inside the role rather than beside it. 

This role carries overall responsibility for a platform that supports finance, property and transactional operations across a pan-European business. It is a leadership role with a small, senior, multidisciplinary team. 

Finance Systems defines what the platform should deliver by setting the functional roadmap, business priority, investment cases and benefits. The D365 Platform Manager owns whether it works through effective management of service stability, change, environments, security design, improvement and the supplier ecosystem. Both are accountable for achieving the same outcome and neither can succeed alone. 

The role operates within the enterprise service management framework set by the Senior Service Delivery Manager and chairs the change advisory board for the platform.

Main Responsibilities 

Run: Service Stability and Operations 

 • Own the availability, performance and reliability of the D365 service for all live countries, including period-end and out-of-hours cover arrangements. 

 • Own diagnosis. Every incident referred to a supplier leaves Logicor with a reproduction and a hypothesis attached, not a forwarded ticket. 

 • Manage incident, problem and request processes for the platform in line with the enterprise service management framework, escalating major incidents through the enterprise process. 

 • Own the consolidated backlog across break-fix, maintenance and improvement, and the prioritisation forum that ranks it with Finance Systems. 

 • Own the second-line functional capability, including the competency path that builds in-house depth and reduces dependency on external support.

Maintain: Change, Compliance and Security 

 • Chair the change advisory board for the platform and approve production change. 

 • Hold design authority for the security role model, including role architecture, privilege design and segregation-of-duties principles. Publication and administration of role changes sit with Application Support, so that the approver of a change is never its executor. 

 • Own the technical debt register, platform currency, regulatory and statutory changes, and the annual upgrade cycle. 

 • Own the pre-go-live configuration and data readiness checklist applied to every new country or entity, built from defect history and operational experience rather than from theory.

 • Own disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements for the platform, including tested recovery. 

Improve: Continuous Improvement and Architecture 

 • Own the continuous improvement pipeline and protect its capacity from incident demand. 

 • Own architecture and technical direction for the platform, working with Enterprise Architecture on design assurance, and direct the D365 Architect on design standards, integration patterns and roadmap alignment. 

 • Own automation, self-service and knowledge management that reduce demand at source. 

 • Evidence the value of improvement work in service and business terms. 

People and Supplier Leadership 

 • Lead, develop and performance-manage the service line: functional consultants, developer, architect and release and environment manager. 

 • Manage the supplier ecosystem for the platform as one, including the managed service partner, independent software vendors and the platform vendor, with a single performance scorecard owned by Logicor. 

 • Hold suppliers to contracted service levels, attribution of defects, and remediation, and maintain the commercial evidence needed to do so. 

 • Direct all contracted capacity against a defined outcome and a handover artefact, so that capability transfers into Logicor rather than remaining with the supplier. 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

Experience & Qualifications 

 • Substantial experience owning a live Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations service in a multi-country organisation, through and beyond hypercare. 

 • Credible across both functional and technical conversations: able to challenge a functional design decision and a technical one in the same meeting. 

 • Proven line leadership of a mixed functional and technical team, including contract resource. 

 • Strong working knowledge of the D365 security role model, Lifecycle Services, environment management, One Version and the release process. 

 • Demonstrable experience holding implementation partners and independent software vendors to contracted outcomes, including disputed defect attribution. 

 • Experience of finance processes end to end; property or real estate module exposure is a strong advantage. 

 • Certifications such as ITIL v4 and relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365 credentials are desirable. 

Key Success Measures 

 • Single accountable ownership of the D365 service demonstrably in place for all live countries. 

 • Open ticket queue stable or falling as country count grows, with mean time in system reducing. 

 • 90% of issues reproduced and hypothesised in-house before being passed to a third party. 

 • Change success rate, emergency change rate and post-release incidents trending favourably. 

 • Improvement capacity ring-fenced and delivering measurable enhancement throughput. 

 • Pre-go-live checklist applied to every wave, with a falling rate of repeat defect classes country on country. 

 • Vendor performance evidenced by an internally owned scorecard, with disputes resolved rather than aged.

That scope covers end-user computing, network and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, and the full business applications estate, including the finance and property ERP platform, the property management system, planning, consolidation, product information, HR and facilities management systems, and the data platform. 

The role will establish a robust IT Service Management (ITSM) framework, strengthen governance and service accountability, and centralise fragmented or “shadow IT” processes across the business.

This position requires an experienced, hands-on Manager who can bring operational discipline, define measurable service standards, and improve user experience through best-practice service delivery, reporting, and performance management. We are looking for someone who is skilled and comfortable creating and agreeing a service strategy; driving the transformation; and then leading its operation and continuous improvement

This is not a platform role. Individual platform service owners are accountable for the availability, change and improvement of their own services. The Service Delivery Manager defines the framework they work to, holds them to it, consolidates the enterprise picture, and runs major-incident governance across all of them.

Main Responsibilities 

Service Management & Transformation 

 • Design, implement, and embed a full ITIL-based ITSM framework (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, CMDB, etc.) within 6 months. 

 • Define and publish the enterprise service catalogue, SLAs, OLAs, and KPIs aligned with business needs. 

 • Drive a shift from reactive IT support to proactive, metric-driven service management. 

 • Implement continuous improvement cycles, service reviews, and CSI plans, and ensure improvement capacity is protected from incident demand. 

Enterprise Oversight Across Portfolios 

 • Set and maintain the common standard for demand intake, classification, prioritisation and operational acceptance that every portfolio applies. 

 • Own enterprise major-incident and escalation management, including the cross-portfolio bridge, communications and post-incident reviews. 

 • Operate a single enterprise view of service demand, delivery capacity, dependencies and delivery risk, so leadership can prioritise across Business Technology as one function. 

 • Chair the periodic portfolio and demand reviews with the Business Technology leadership team. 

 • Assure that no service, application or significant change enters live support without documented ownership, runbooks, monitoring and a support model. 

Operational Oversight

 • Provide leadership and direction for IT Operations through a dotted-line relationship, ensuring accountability and consistency across all regions. 

 • Oversee desktop support, infrastructure operations, and managed service partners to deliver a seamless service across Europe. 

 • Establish clear escalation, major-incident, and problem-management processes. 

 • Ensure accurate tracking and reporting through Logicor's ITSM toolset (Jira Service Management or equivalent). 

Vendor & Partner Management 

 • Govern all third-party managed service providers across end-user computing, infrastructure, networks, security operations and business applications, with structured service reviews and measurable outcomes. 

 • Monitor vendor SLAs, credits, and KPIs, and ensure value for money. 

 • Maintain a consolidated performance dashboard and manage service escalations effectively. 

 • Ensure supplier performance evidence is produced and owned by Logicor rather than self-reported by the supplier. 

Governance & Process Control 

 • Identify and eliminate shadow IT, bringing systems, contracts, and support arrangements under IT governance. 

 • Centralise and standardise IT operational processes, documentation, and knowledge bases. 

 • Ensure compliance with IT Security, Risk, and Governance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, AI Act readiness). 

 • Work closely with IT Operations, Security, Applications, Data and PMO teams to maintain alignment. 

User Experience & Reporting 

 • Champion a customer-centric service culture with measurable satisfaction and improvement plans. 

 • Deliver service dashboards and reports to IT leadership and ExCo, highlighting trends and outcomes. 

 • Promote IT service awareness and education across Logicor. 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

 Experience & Qualifications 

 • 10+ years in IT Service Delivery or IT Operations leadership within a complex, multi-site or pan-European environment. 

 • Proven track record of implementing ITIL v4 and ITSM tools (e.g. Jira Service Management, ServiceNow). 

 • Experience operating a service framework across a mixed estate of infrastructure and business applications, including at least one major ERP platform. 

 • Strong governance, process design, and performance-management skills. 

 • Experienced in managing MSPs, SaaS vendors, and internal IT teams. 

 • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication at senior-leadership level. 

 • Confident in data-driven service reporting and KPI analysis. 

 • Certifications such as ITIL v4 Expert, COBIT, ISO 20000, PRINCE2, or equivalent are highly desirable. 

Key Success Measures 

 • ITSM framework designed, approved, and operational within 6 months, and adopted by every portfolio. 

 • A single enterprise demand and capacity view in use by leadership for prioritisation. 

 • Reduction of shadow IT and centralised visibility of all IT services and assets. 

 • SLA and KPI compliance achieved across incidents, requests, and changes. 

 • Major-incident process exercised and evidenced, with post-incident reviews closed to action. 

 • Quarterly service-performance reviews delivered to ExCo. 

 • Positive upward trend in user satisfaction scores and service metrics. 

 • Measurable improvements in partner performance and contract governance.

Who are we
At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.
By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.
Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.
Location
While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.
This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.
About the Team
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.
AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped.
For this role, you’ll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you’ll own the team’s strategy and delivery end to end.
What You Will Do
Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar.
Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.
Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs.
Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt.
Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable.
Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability.
Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the services your teams run and step in as Incident Commander when needed.
Own your teams' delivery: set quarterly plans, track progress against the product roadmap and help shape department-wide planning and strategy.
What You Must Have
3+ years of recent experience as an Engineering Manager leading software engineering teams, ideally in SaaS product companies.
A strong software engineering background, and you're still hands-on today. You can review code and designs credibly, dig into technical issues and contribute to architecture decisions.
Proven people leadership: hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management and helping engineers grow into their next role.
A strong product engineering mindset. You've partnered with Product and Design on discovery, worked directly with customers and measured success by customer and business outcomes rather than output.
Business acumen. You understand the commercial context, can explain trade-offs in terms of impact and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.
Experience using engineering metrics and flow practices (such as DORA metrics, cycle time or WIP limits) to find bottlenecks and improve delivery, quality and team health, without turning metrics into targets.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and agentic tools, both in your own work and across a team. You have a clear view of how AI changes delivery speed, code quality, review practices and cognitive load.
Experience planning and delivering complex initiatives across several teams predictably, including managing dependencies, risks and incidents.
It's a Plus If You Have
None of these are required, and we're happy to support you as you learn them on the job.
Experience in the localization industry or with translation workflows.
Experience leading engineering teams at a product company during a scale-up phase.
Experience shipping AI-powered product features, such as LLM-based features, to customers.
Experience managing fully remote, distributed teams.
Familiarity with developer experience or productivity frameworks, such as SPACE or DevEx.
Our Benefits
💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.
We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

The LME drives revenue from three interlinked sources, the first is transaction fees from trading and clearing. The second is recurring income from market data licensing and data services, built on the prices and activity the market creates. The third is from Sustainability and Physical Markets.

Overall Purpose of Role
· Revenue Operations will bring the three revenue sources together and the role will build the exchange’s first integrated view of commercial performance, linking volumes, participants, products and data consumption to the revenue they generate.
· Working with Commercial Strategy and Partnerships, business lines (Trading, Market data, Sustainability and Physical Markets), finance and the exchanges central functions, the individual will design and deliver an internal Management Information System (MIS).

Responsibilities

· Develop and maintain a consolidated MIS framework that provides a single view of revenue across trading, clearing and market data, including analysis by product, contract, client segment, member and channel, with volume, fee and license drivers. This will be done by tracking business performance and identifying issues proactively.
· Partner with Global Client Development, Relationship Management, Finance, Market Data and Physical Market teams to define business requirements and establish key performance metrics. Identify processes so opportunities are not missed. Run discovery sessions with commercial and business teams to agree which metrics and views are a priority and deliver a MIS roadmap aligned with strategic objectives.
· Design, build and continuously enhance the MIS covering data models, metric definitions, dashboards and regular reporting packs, integrating multiple data sources to deliver a single source of truth for commercial performance reporting.
· Set up regular revenue performance reviews and produce Executive-level reporting and insights for senior leadership team. Include trends, variance to plan, client and product concentration, early indicators of growth or attrition and any other applicable metrics as appropriate.
• Support Group-wide pricing, fee change, new product launches and commercial strategy decisions through detailed analysis of likely volume and revenue impacts, while monitoring and evaluating post-implementation performance.
• Drive automation, operational efficiency and process improvement initiatives by consolidating data from multiple systems, streamlining reporting processes and reducing manual intervention.
• Establish and maintain governance over commercial data, metric definitions and reporting standards for the function, ensuring data quality, reconciliation and consistent interpretation across theorganisation. Own the commercial data definitions and governance for the function and document them so that they last beyond individual analysts.

Required Knowledge and Level of Experience:
· Proven experience in revenue operations, commercial finance, business analytics or MIS. Experience within financial markets, including exchanges, clearing houses, market data providers or financial information business is highly desirable.
· Strong understanding of exchange and market infrastructure revenue models, including transaction-based trading and clearing fees, as well as subscription and licensing and data revenue streams.
· Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into clear insights, actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.
· Strong technical capability in data analysis and visualisation tools, including SQL and platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, with a hands-on approach to designing, building and maintaining reporting solutions.
· Demonstrated ability to gather, challenge and prioritise requirements from senior stakeholders across multiple business functions and translate them into scalable reporting and MI solutions.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting insights and recommendations to both front-line managers and senior leadership teams.
• Highly structured and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data governance, metric definitions and reconciliation, and ensuring reporting accuracy and consistency.
· Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, concise and commercially meaningful way, helping stakeholders understand implications and drive informed decision-making.
· Experience constructing a reporting function or MIS from concept would be a distinct advantage.

Skills set and Core Competencies Required for Role:
· Strong analytical skills
· Advanced Microsoft Excel User
· Skills in language programming, ideally SQL, Python
· Experience using applications e.g. SalesForce
· Experience with dashboard reporting tools such as PowerBi
· Familiarity with Bloomberg and Reuters desirable

In doing so, we want every LME employee to feel our commitment to showing respect for all and encouraging open collaboration and communication.

Our Security Team is at the heart of keeping London Southend Airport safe, secure and welcoming. As Security Team Leader you will lead a team of Ground Security Officers throughout their shift, driving operational excellence, supporting day-to-day security activities and ensuring that every passenger enjoys a smooth, safe and efficient journey from the moment they arrive.

Key Responsibilities
As a Security Team Leader, no two days are ever the same. You'll play a key role developing our Ground Security Officers and keeping our airport and passengers safe. Your responsibilities will include:
• Leading, coaching and developing a team of Ground Security Officers
• Supporting recruitment, colleague development and performance management activities
• Allocating of resources to ensure operational and security requirements are met
• Compliance monitoring
• Responding to operational incidents, alarms and security-related issues
• Support in the delivery of a safe, warm, professional and efficient service to passengers.
• Screening passengers and baggage in accordance with CAA regulations.
• Conducting CCTV monitoring and security patrols across the airport.
• Completing administrative duties and maintaining relevant documentation.
• Deputise for the Security Duty Manager or Control Centre Supervisors when required
• Working collaboratively with colleagues to keep the airport operating safely and smoothly.

• As you will be operating the X-Ray Machines, you will be required to pass a colour-blind test

• Strong communication skills
• Experience working within Aviation Security
• Ground Security Officer Level 1

Desirable:

• Supporting with updates to Company policies and procedures in timely manner with legislation and business changes
• Managing HR administration across the full employee lifecycle for Lucy Group Ltd, ensuring employee records and documentation are maintained accurately and in accordance with Company processes.
We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual who will proactively support HR activities. This role is ideal for someone with employee relations experience and strong interpersonal skills who is seeking exposure to wider HR initiatives, while also being willing to support day-to-day operational HR activities.
Job Dimensions:
• This is a full time, fixed term role for a period of 12 months
• This is a hybrid role as per our Working Arrangements Policy and will be based in the Oxford site with travel to Thame
• This role will report to the HR Manager and will be part of the wider HR Central Team

Key Accountabilities:
• Responsible for supporting and advising the business on employee relations issues including but not limited to dispute resolution, disciplinaries, grievances, absence management, and performance management
• Advise managers on management practice and ensure compliance with policies and procedures including in Employee Relations issues
• Preparing HR documentation, including invitation letters, outcome letters and performance management documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance 
• Support with ensuring policy, procedures, and forms are up to date, in line with current legislation and maintained according to ISO standards
• Responsible for ensuring the shared drives, employee files and relevant trackers are maintained and up to date
• Ensure the HR system (Oracle) is kept up to date and accurate and provide reports from Oracle on request
• Support with running and checking monthly payroll reports
• Support with all aspects of the Employee lifecycle, including but not limited to induction and onboarding, contractual changes, development, benefits and leaver process
• Supporting the team with general administration across all areas of HR 
• Supporting the wider HR Central team with HR operational activities and project work

Qualifications, Experience & Skills
• CIPD Level 3 qualified 
• HR experience in a generalist role
• Experience of managing and advising on Employee Relations activities including but not limited to Performance Management, Grievances, Disciplinaries, Absence Management
• Good understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practice.
• Ability to balance business needs with employee experience and policy compliance.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Desirable Experience
• Working towards CIPD Level 5
• Worked in a Manufacturing and Engineering Environment
• Experience in using Oracle HRIS

Behavioural Competencies:
• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
• Excellent time management skills
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Resilient and can work at pace on different priorities to meet deadlines
• Proactive, positive and can-do approach to resolving issues
• A process improvement mindset 
• Proactive, takes the initiative and effectively deals with resistance
• Trusted, credible team player as well as working independently 
• "Role models" the values and demonstrates a strong moral compass in all decision making.
• Flexible approach to delivering excellent service
• Ability to travel to other sites

Values
• Caring – We treat all with fairness and respect. We value diversity. We recognise and develop our people

• Working Together – Teamworking and communication are at the forefront of everything we do. We share our knowledge across our organisation for the benefit of all.
• Trusted – We build and maintain trusted relationships with all people and partners
• Daring to Differentiate – We are market leaders. We make bold decisions. We stand out.

Responsibilities:

2) HR Data Management: Carry out complex HR data processing tasks; advise colleagues when needed and use expertise to help improve data collection tools and administration processes.

As a Backend Engineer, you will be the backbone of our data infrastructure, working directly with our Lead Backend Engineer to transition our systems into a high-performance, unified platform. - Experience contributing across backend and frontend boundaries in production systems.
- Participation in security reviews, bug bounties, hackathons, or other hands-on engineering competitions.

- Ownership: driving engineering teams to own their infrastructure and costs by building great tooling, visibility and documentation
- Security: Setting the standards for fine-grained access to systems and applications to allow automated access control and support auditing requirements
